profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at CrowdStrike
profile.summary:
I build frontend experiences that scale. From powering Warcraft III's in game UI to securing enterprise assets at CrowdStrike.

with 10+ years of experience in front-end and full-stack development, I specialize in React, Typescript, Javascript, Node.js etc. I've shipped production software for household names likes Blizzard Entertainment, Zenimax, and Experian and workin across gaming, cybersecurity, fintech and eCommerce.

At CrowdStrike I am one of the leads of UI development on Exposure management organization, building Risk score and analysis, Attack path modules and Asset management that help organizations monitor and protect their entire asset ecosystem. 

What drives me: crafting intuitive, performant interfaces that make complex systems feel simple while maintaining scalable architecture and designs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior UI Engineer on the Exposure Management team, leading frontend systems across Exposure Management, Asset Management, and Risk Analytics to help enterprises identify and eliminate security risks at scale.
	•	Built the Attack Path module, visually mapping threat vectors across devices, identities, and cloud assets to help teams close security gaps proactively.
	•	Developed the Asset Inventory UI, giving security teams unified visibility into managed and unmanaged devices with powerful filtering and search at enterprise scale.
	•	Shipped the AI powered Risk Score module for agentic experience, delivering real-time risk ratings and analytics that translate security findings into actionable insights for technical and executive stakeholders.
	•	Leveraged AI-assisted development tools (including Claude code) to accelerate development throughput, code quality, and delivery velocity.

Stack: EmberJS · Tailwind CSS · TypeScript · JavaScript
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Team Leadership · Team Coordination · Front-end Coding · Claude Skills

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Principal/Senior Software Engineer at West Monroe (acquired Verys), a national technology consulting firm delivering solutions across transformative industries.
	•	Built a full-stack NFT eCommerce platform for Unfinished Labs, enabling digital asset discovery, purchase, and management.
	•	Developed Player Experience web applications for ZeniMax, improving how millions of players interact with game services online.

positions.title: Contract Senior Web Engineer
positions.description:
Contract Senior Web Engineer at ZeniMax Media, maintaining and expanding web properties for one of gaming’s most iconic publishers.
	•	Maintained and enhanced Bethesda.net, ensuring a reliable and performant experience for millions of players worldwide.
	•	Built new game launch sites for upcoming titles, architecting content models in Contentful and developing reusable component libraries aligned with the latest design systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description: Built the full in-game UI for Warcraft III: Reforged using React, Redux, and Redux-Saga inside a custom CEF browser, communicating with the C++ game client via WebSocket. Also developed Player Experience web applications for ZeniMax.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Delivered projects across Experian, and Blizzard Entertainment — redesigning Experian’s consumer Dashboard and Report pages, building Blizzard’s internal eSports Platform, and developing Nostradamus, an internal timesheet and project management tool.

positions.description: - MyTespa rebuild for Blizzard Entertainment

positions.title: Contract Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Led a User Interface team that was working on Warcraft III: Reforged video game.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on developing UI for Warcraft III: Reforged video game with React and LESS

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked on creating a dashboard experience for Experian webapp where users can get an overview of their financial profile using AngularJS and SASS
- Worked on recreating report page experience with updated designs and features AngularJS and SASS

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description: Collaborated with client team for building internal eSports Platform tool using React/Redux with TypeScript.

positions.title: Contract Software Developer
positions.description:
Rebuilt MyTespa for Blizzard Entertainment using a microservices architecture, delivering a multi-role application with an atomic design component library and inline CMS capabilities for admin users.
Stack: Node.js/Express · Docker · Sequelize · jQuery · Jade/Pug · SASS

positions.title: Contract Front End Engineer
positions.description: Owned the frontend codebase for Blizzard’s Forums Web App, building moderator/admin web services, reusable UI components, and CMS enhancements. Also maintained game sites for Heroes of the Storm and StarCraft 2.
